machine_checks: Candidate vulnerable record exists in frozen clean TRAIN bank with label == 1
Candidate patched record exists in frozen clean TRAIN bank with label == 0
Both records originate from the same dataset split (no cross-dataset or cross-split pairs)
Records are free from duplicate or conflicting-label quarantine flags
artifacts: discovery_manifest.json (candidate IDs, split tags, initial labels, dataset hashes)
failure_behavior: Drop candidate pair immediately. Never search outside frozen clean TRAIN bank.

machine_checks: Repository URL resolves to valid upstream source repository
File path matches exactly between vulnerable parent and fix child revisions
Parent revision is a valid, distinct 40-character hexadecimal git commit SHA
Fix revision is a valid, distinct 40-character hexadecimal git commit SHA
SHA-256 of extracted vulnerable function bytes matches archived raw bytes file
SHA-256 of extracted patched function bytes matches archived raw bytes file
Unified diff between parent and fix revisions strictly accounts for changed function lines
Canonical payload generated and canonical_payload_sha256 computed deterministically
human_checks: Verify security rationale source reference (commit message, CVE advisory, PR notes) is authentic and not guessed
failure_behavior: Reject candidate. If formatting mismatches exist, halt and document disclosed protocol decision. Never forge or guess missing history.

machine_checks: Two distinct reviewer records exist (reviewer_1_id != reviewer_2_id)
Both reviews bind to the exact identical canonical_payload_sha256
Timestamps are valid ISO-8601 UTC timestamps falling within active review window
failure_behavior: Reject candidate if any assertion is false, if reviewers match, or if any approval is missing or unverified. Model output cannot substitute for human review.

machine_checks: Verify cryptographic signature / payload binding for both reviewer sign-offs
Verify all 8 boolean criteria across both reviewers evaluate to true
Verify zero duplicate admission of identical pair hash into B3 bank
Append verified pair to admitted_b3_exemplars.jsonl with immutable entry timestamp
failure_behavior: Halt admission pipeline. Emit verification failure error log with failed check identifiers.

machine_checks: Exemplar selected from admitted_b3_exemplars.jsonl using pre-registered deterministic indexing
Selection process has zero access to test split feature matrices or test labels
human_checks: Audit selection logic to ensure strict blinding against test split distributions
failure_behavior: Abort selection. Revert to pre-registered fallback demonstration if selection violates blinding criteria.

machine_checks: Prompt conforms strictly to section order: role_domain -> target_code -> question -> node_info -> edge_info -> demonstration -> answer
Demonstration token count <= 1500 tokens
Total assembled prompt length <= 8192 token context budget
Target code label (0 or 1) does not appear anywhere in prompt text
Cryptographic SHA-256 computed and recorded for frozen prompt template
human_checks: Inspect rendered prompt instances to confirm demonstration format and explanation integrity
failure_behavior: Halt pipeline. Refactor prompt formatting or trim demonstration commentary within sourced bounds. Do not truncate target code.

machine_checks: Run inference across 100% of validation split (N=2,732 Devign; N=2,273 REVEAL)
Re-estimate optimal decision threshold tau* exclusively on validation predictions
Verify tau* optimizes pre-registered validation objective metric
Update configs/thresholds.json and re-sign with SHA-256 self-checksum
human_checks: Confirm validation threshold optimization script executed without data leakage from test split
failure_behavior: Abort before test run. If validation fails or yields non-monotonic metrics, investigate and record audit log.

machine_checks: Verify configs/thresholds.json self-signing checksum matches registered value
Run inference across full fixed test census (Devign Test N=2,732; REVEAL Test N=2,274)
Inherit tau* directly from Stage 7 without test-split tuning
Execute paired cluster bootstrap (B=5000, seed=20261117)
Apply Holm-Bonferroni family correction across contrast family
human_checks: Audit test execution log to confirm strict adherence to frozen registration parameters
failure_behavior: Halt execution. Never apply post-hoc tuning or early stopping on test split.
